questions.note: The Path provides safe houses, new identities, and routes away from the Empire.

questions.question: What is the Bad Batch's official unit designation?
questions.note: Clone Force 99 originally consists of Hunter, Wrecker, Tech, and Crosshair.

questions.question: Which squad leader has enhanced tracking senses?
questions.note: Hunter's keen senses help him track targets and assess his surroundings.

questions.question: Which Bad Batch member specializes in computers and technical analysis?
questions.note: Tech can solve technical problems faster than many droids.

questions.question: What is the name of Wrecker's tooka doll?
questions.note: Lula is Wrecker's soft toy and also comforts Omega.

questions.question: Who works as Nala Se's medical assistant before joining Clone Force 99?
questions.note: Omega spends her early life in Tipoca City on Kamino.

questions.question: Which Bad Batch member is the squad's sniper?
questions.note: Crosshair's enhanced eyesight gives him exceptional long-range accuracy.

questions.question: Which presumed-dead ARC trooper is rescued on Skako Minor and joins the Bad Batch?
questions.note: Rex helps rescue Echo after discovering the Separatists are using him.

questions.question: Which island refuge offers Omega and the squad a peaceful home?
questions.note: Phee Genoa introduces the squad to the refugee community on Pabu.

questions.question: On which world in another galaxy are Ezra and Thrawn found?
questions.note: Peridea lies at the end of an intergalactic purrgil migration route.

questions.question: Which space-whales can naturally travel through hyperspace?
questions.note: Purrgil use interstellar gases to fuel their natural hyperspace jumps.

questions.question: Which ancient droid helps young Jedi construct their lightsabers?
questions.note: Professor Huyang preserves centuries of lightsaber designs and Jedi knowledge.

questions.question: Who is Baylan Skoll's apprentice?
questions.note: Shin and Baylan work as mercenaries allied with Morgan Elsbeth.

questions.question: Morgan Elsbeth belongs to which tradition of witches?
questions.note: Morgan is a survivor of the Nightsisters of Dathomir.

questions.question: Who are Jacen Syndulla's parents?
questions.note: Jacen is the son of Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus.

questions.question: What enormous hyperspace transport does Morgan build to reach Thrawn?
questions.note: The Eye of Sion is a giant hyperspace ring used for the intergalactic journey.

questions.question: What does Thrawn study to understand his enemies' behavior?
questions.note: Thrawn believes art reveals how a people thinks and fights.

questions.question: Which assassin becomes Boba Fett's closest partner in The Book of Boba Fett?
questions.note: Fennec helps Boba build and defend his position on Tatooine.

questions.question: Who faces Boba Fett in the finale's western-style street duel?
questions.note: Cad Bane works for the Pykes and confronts his former protégé.

questions.question: What species is the black-furred bounty hunter Krrsantan?
questions.note: Krrsantan is a Wookiee gladiator turned bounty hunter.

questions.question: Who is the marshal of Mos Pelgo who wears Boba's recovered armor?
questions.note: Cobb buys the armor from Jawas and uses it to protect his town.

questions.question: Which anthology begins with nine anime shorts made by Japanese studios?
questions.note: Visions volume 1 presents independent anime interpretations of Star Wars.

questions.question: Which orderly planet is home to the four children in Skeleton Crew?
questions.note: Wim, Neel, Fern, and KB begin their journey on At Attin.

questions.question: Which ship takes the Skeleton Crew children away from home?
questions.note: The children discover the buried Onyx Cinder and accidentally leave their world.

questions.question: Which pair are the twin sisters at the center of The Acolyte?
questions.note: Mae and Osha Aniseya grow up in a coven on Brendok.

decks.name: Star Wars 4 · Deep cuts
decks.subtitle: 64 questions · Lore, aliens, production, performers and games. Book continuity is labeled where relevant.

questions.question: Which ancient Sith Lord establishes the Rule of Two?
questions.note: Bane limits the Sith to a master and an apprentice to curb destructive infighting.

questions.question: Which first Mandalorian Jedi creates the Darksaber?
questions.note: Tarre creates the blade; Pre Vizsla wields it much later during the Clone Wars.

questions.question: What is the usual title for a Jedi apprentice assigned to a teacher?
questions.note: Ahsoka becomes Anakin's Padawan at age fourteen.

questions.question: Which artifact stores teachings that require the Force to unlock?
questions.note: Jedi and Sith holocrons preserve knowledge for later generations.

questions.question: What microscopic life forms help living beings communicate with the Force?
questions.note: Midi-chlorians live symbiotically inside cells; they are not the Force itself.

questions.question: Where do younglings seek lightsaber crystals during the Gathering in The Clone Wars?
questions.note: The Gathering takes younglings into Ilum's crystal caves.

questions.question: Which world is home to Mother Talzin's Nightsister clan?
questions.note: Dathomir is the home of Talzin's Nightsisters and the Nightbrothers.

questions.question: Which ancient Sith world does Yoda visit in The Clone Wars episode "Sacrifice"?
questions.note: Moraband contains the Valley of the Dark Lords and Darth Bane's tomb.

questions.question: What species is Admiral Ackbar?
questions.note: Ackbar is a Mon Calamari; Quarren are another species from the same ocean world.

questions.question: What species is the green-skinned bounty hunter Greedo?
questions.note: Greedo is a Rodian with large eyes and short antennae.

questions.question: Which species does Jabba belong to?
questions.note: Jabba is a Hutt crime lord; Gamorreans serve among his guards.

questions.question: What is Yoda's species officially called in the Star Wars Databank?
questions.note: The Databank lists Yoda's species as unknown; Grogu does not establish a species name.

questions.question: Which species is the blue musician Max Rebo?
questions.note: Max Rebo is an Ortolan with a trunk-like nose.

questions.question: What kind of creature is Jabba's cackling companion Salacious Crumb?
questions.note: Kowakian monkey-lizards are known for their incessant laughter.

questions.question: What species is Lando's Falcon co-pilot Nien Nunb?
questions.note: Nien Nunb is a Sullustan and flies with Lando at Endor.

questions.question: Which species is cantina musician Figrin D'an?
questions.note: Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes are the Bith band in the Mos Eisley cantina.

questions.question: What do the letters TIE in TIE fighter stand for?
questions.note: TIE means Twin Ion Engine, not a description of the ship's bow-tie silhouette.

questions.question: What does AT-AT stand for?
questions.note: The All Terrain Armored Transport combines troop transport with heavy firepower.

questions.question: What distinguishes Maul's lightsaber in The Phantom Menace?
options: Two blades extending from one hilt
questions.note: Maul's double-bladed weapon is also called a saberstaff.

questions.question: What gives Kylo Ren's lightsaber its crossguard shape?
questions.note: Side vents form the small quillon blades on Kylo's unstable saber.

questions.question: What is a GNK or "gonk" droid's main job?
questions.note: GNK droids are walking power generators.

questions.question: What is the holographic creature board game played aboard the Falcon called?
questions.note: Dejarik uses holographic creatures; sabacc is a card game.

questions.question: Which event is the reference point for dates labeled BBY and ABY?
questions.note: BBY means Before the Battle of Yavin; ABY means After the Battle of Yavin.

questions.question: In A New Hope, C-3PO claims fluency in over how many forms of communication?
questions.note: C-3PO boasts that he is fluent in over six million forms of communication.

questions.question: What is Grand Moff Tarkin's first name?
questions.note: Wilhuff Tarkin commands the first Death Star.

questions.question: Which Rebel pilot uses the call sign Red Six at Yavin?
questions.note: Porkins is Red Six; Luke is Red Five.

questions.question: Who is Luke's snowspeeder gunner during the Battle of Hoth?
questions.note: Dak is killed during the attack; Wes Janson is Wedge's gunner.

questions.question: Which Star Destroyer captures Leia's ship above Tatooine in A New Hope?
questions.note: Devastator is the pursuing Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the opening scene.

questions.question: What huge tracked vehicle do Jawas use to transport salvaged droids?
questions.note: Jawas trade droids and scrap from their sandcrawlers.

questions.question: Which bounty hunter does Leia impersonate to infiltrate Jabba's palace?
questions.note: Leia wears Boushh's helmet and brings in Chewbacca as a supposed captive.

questions.question: Which couple raises Luke on their moisture farm?
questions.note: Luke knows Owen and Beru as his uncle and aunt.

questions.question: Which Ewok first befriends Leia after her speeder-bike chase?
questions.note: Wicket W. Warrick approaches Leia and helps her evade Imperial scouts.

questions.question: Who directs The Empire Strikes Back?
questions.note: Kershner directs Episode V; Lucas provides the story and produces.

questions.question: Who directs Return of the Jedi?
questions.note: Marquand directs the original trilogy's final film.

questions.question: Who composes the score for Rogue One?
questions.note: Giacchino scores Rogue One while using some established Star Wars musical themes.

questions.question: Who composes the score for Solo: A Star Wars Story?
questions.note: Powell writes the score; John Williams contributes a new Han Solo theme.

questions.question: Who composes The Mandalorian's main theme and season 1 score?
questions.note: Göransson creates the series' distinctive recorder-led sound.

questions.question: Which sound designer creates many iconic Star Wars sounds, including Vader's breathing?
questions.note: Burtt builds the galaxy's soundscape from recordings of real machines, animals, and other sources.

questions.question: Who creates The Mandalorian television series?
questions.note: Favreau creates the series and develops it with fellow executive producer Dave Filoni.

questions.question: Which concept artist helps define the original designs of Vader and C-3PO?
questions.note: McQuarrie's concept paintings shape the look of the original trilogy and later projects.

questions.question: Who plays Qui-Gon Jinn in The Phantom Menace?
questions.note: Neeson plays Qui-Gon; McGregor plays his apprentice Obi-Wan.

questions.question: Who plays Count Dooku in Episodes II and III?
questions.note: Christopher Lee plays Dooku; his fellow horror-film star Peter Cushing plays Tarkin.

questions.question: Which actor plays Palpatine in Return of the Jedi and the prequel trilogy?
questions.note: McDiarmid plays both the public politician and the Sith Lord behind the mask.

questions.question: Which actor performs C-3PO in the original trilogy?
questions.note: Daniels provides C-3PO's voice and the performance inside the golden costume.

questions.question: Who provides Yoda's voice in The Empire Strikes Back?
questions.note: Oz voices and puppeteers Yoda; Tom Kane voices Yoda in The Clone Wars.

questions.question: Which actor plays both Snoke and Andor's Kino Loy?
questions.note: Serkis plays both characters, but Kino and Snoke are different people.

questions.question: Which actor is credited as Din Djarin in The Mandalorian?
questions.note: Pascal plays Din; stunt performers also contribute the armored physical performance.

questions.question: Who voices Ahsoka in The Clone Wars and Rebels?
questions.note: Eckstein voices animated Ahsoka; Dawson plays her in live action.

questions.question: Which fake production title conceals the filming of Return of the Jedi?
questions.note: Blue Harvest is a cover title used during production.

questions.question: What announced title preceded Return of the Jedi before "Return" replaced one word?
questions.note: Revenge of the Jedi even appeared in early promotional material.

questions.question: Which country supplies the jungle-temple location shots for Yavin 4 in A New Hope?
questions.note: The Mayan ruins at Tikal in Guatemala stand in for the Rebel base.

questions.question: In which country is Finse, the snowy location used for Hoth?
questions.note: Finse, Norway provides the real snow and ice for Hoth location filming.

questions.question: Which North African country hosts the Mos Espa set for The Phantom Menace?
questions.note: The crew films Tatooine scenes in Tunisia and rebuilds after a destructive storm.

questions.question: In which year does The Phantom Menace first release?
questions.note: The prequel releases are 1999, 2002, and 2005.

questions.question: In which year does The Empire Strikes Back first release?
questions.note: The original trilogy releases are 1977, 1980, and 1983.

questions.question: In which year does the original trilogy return to cinemas as the Special Editions?
questions.note: The 1997 Special Editions mark twenty years since the first film.

questions.question: Which Jedi is the protagonist of Jedi: Fallen Order and Jedi: Survivor?
questions.note: Cal survives Order 66 as Jaro Tapal's Padawan and later fights the Empire.

questions.question: Which small exploration droid accompanies Cal Kestis?
questions.note: BD-1 helps Cal explore, scan his surroundings, and survive dangerous environments.

questions.question: Who is the four-armed captain of the Stinger Mantis?
questions.note: Greez is a Latero pilot and an enthusiastic cook.

questions.question: What is Cal's ability to sense an object's past called?
questions.note: Psychometry lets Cal experience Force echoes connected to objects.

questions.question: Who writes the 1991 novel Heir to the Empire, which introduces Thrawn?
questions.note: Zahn creates Thrawn in the original book trilogy, now classified as Legends.

questions.question: Which banner is applied to much of the older Expanded Universe after the 2014 continuity announcement?
questions.note: Legends preserves the older continuity separately; characters can still be reintroduced into canon.

questions.question: Which Sith antagonist is central to The Old Republic's Legacy of the Sith expansion?
questions.note: Legacy of the Sith follows the plans of the renegade Darth Malgus in the game's Legends setting.

questions.question: What is the name of Kay Vess's merqaal companion in Star Wars Outlaws?
questions.note: Nix is Kay's loyal companion and helps with distractions, theft, and combat.
